```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/**'

jobs:
  publish-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v3
        with:
          gradle-version: '7.6'

      - name: Check Base Version
        id: check_version
        run: |
          BASE_VERSION=$(grep "version=" airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/version.properties | cut -d'=' -f2)
          echo "Base version: $BASE_VERSION"
          
          # Check if version already exists in Maven Central
          MAVEN_REPO_URL="https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/airbyte/bulk-cdk-core-base/$BASE_VERSION"
          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" $MAVEN_REPO_URL)
          
          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
            echo "Version $BASE_VERSION already exists in Maven repository"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "Version $BASE_VERSION does not exist in Maven repository"
          fi

      - name: Build Base Package
        if: steps.check_version.outcome == 'success'
        run: |
          cd airbyte-cdk/bulk
          ./gradlew :core:base:build

      - name: Publish Base Package
        if: steps.check_version.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          cd airbyte-cdk/bulk
          ./gradlew :core:base:publish
```
